Brownian Motion Variance Estimation

Source: R/bm_variance.R
dot-bm_variance.Rd

Estimate the Brownian motion variance parameter from a set of locations using a leave-one-out likelihood approach.

Usage

.bm_variance(time_lag, location_error, x, y)

Arguments

time_lag

Numeric vector of time lags (in minutes).

location_error

Numeric vector of location errors per position.

x

Numeric vector of x coordinates.

y

Numeric vector of y coordinates.

Value

A list with BMvar (the estimated variance) and cll (the conditional log-likelihood).

Details

This is the pure R reference implementation, superseded by the C version in bm_variance_c.c for production use. It implements the leave-one-out approach of Horne et al. (2007).

References

Horne, J. S., Garton, E. O., Krone, S. M., & Lewis, J. S. (2007). Analyzing animal movements using Brownian bridges. Ecology, 88(9), 2354-2363.
